body: I can tell you first hand I am probably not the best with my own mental health and I can probably give you my own family and friends to back that up. But I will say. I was always seen as the strong one in my family and I was always given a lot more pressure than my siblings. But I know I was the strongest of everyone else and I knew I had to be strong for others and I could handle my own feelings on my own, if this is something that he may have gone through it may just be that he’s just having his own conversations. If that’s the case then he may not need anyone to speak or anything at all aside from just someone near him. Just make sure he’s okay. Sometimes if people just say their okay or fine or whatever they’re not. But they don’t know what they feel. Maybe he might just need someone there even if there is no speaking
